text:
emma_csm: Hi team — brief kickoff in 20 to align on SolaceHealth onboarding: owners, critical success metrics, quick timeline. Who can make it?
tyler_pm: I can. I'll own product acceptance + sign-off.
jana_enable: I'll lead enablement and the API walkthrough. Suggested must-haves: end-to-end calls working, sample embeddings spot-check, and Console visibility for ops.
omar_se: I'll prepare payloads and a tiny load script. Flag: customer requested 12mo retention + encryption. Need clarity if pilot requires that.
lee_eng: SSO is planned for GA, ETA ~8 business days. For pilot we can do token auth. I'll log SSO ticket.
emma_csm: Proposed timeline: smoke tests in 48h, internal pilot in 5 days, customer pilot in 10 days. Renewal: renewal window ~11 months — recommend early usage baseline capture (month 2) to reduce risk.
tyler_pm: Actions: @omar_se -> upload sample payloads to s3://redwood-solace/samples by tomorrow 09:30; @lee_eng -> confirm SSO ticket ETA; @jana_enable -> schedule 30m enablement + create 4-question feedback form. I'll draft acceptance checklist.
calendar-bot: Event created: "SolaceHealth onboarding kickoff" at 15:00 PT. Attendees: emma_csm, tyler_pm, jana_enable, omar_se, lee_eng.
omar_se: Uploaded samples + README with curl/python examples to s3.
jana_enable: Draft checklist posted to Confluence (WIP). Plan: 15m demo + 15m Qs. I'll share survey after.
emma_csm: Quick acceptance checklist (to be formalized):
```
- smoke_tests: pass
- p95_latency < 350ms
- embedding_spotcheck >= 0.9
- docs_shared: true
- week1_usage_reported
```
tyler_pm: Also add non-functional: monitoring alerts, cost baseline, fallback model pinned.
emma_csm: I'll set daily 10m standups for the first 4 business days to catch early issues and feedback. Will send 1-pager to sponsor. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
